comment: Data for sisi/discovery.py: what a host's capability listing and delegation tool look like, which flags switch off approvals, which names are never tools, and which names hint at an agent tool. Names of tools and hosts live here, never in code. Paths are dotted keys into the tool's JSON.

driver_format_help.name: short id of the tool, lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore
driver_format_help.exe: the command name as found on PATH (a bare name, no slash); must be the tool itself, never a shell or interpreter
driver_format_help.run: argument list that runs ONE task without interaction; first item is exe; exactly one item is the whole token {prompt}; other whole-token placeholders allowed: {model_flag} {effort_flag} {cwd_flag} {cwd}
driver_format_help.list: argument list that prints the model names one per line, or null
driver_format_help.model_flag: the flag that chooses a model (for {model_flag}), or null
driver_format_help.effort_flag: the flag that chooses reasoning effort (for {effort_flag}), or null
driver_format_help.cwd_flag: the flag that sets the working folder (for {cwd_flag}), or null
driver_format_help.plan: "free", "flat" (a subscription with an allowance) or "per-use"; null when unknown
driver_format_help.auth_signatures: lowercase phrases its output contains when it is not logged in (6 to 80 characters each)
driver_format_help.limit_signatures: lowercase phrases its output contains when a quota or rate limit is hit
driver_format_help.tokens_regex: a regular expression with ONE group that captures the total token count from its output, or null
driver_format_help.approvals_off_reason: only when the tool cannot run without a flag that switches off approvals or its sandbox: say why
driver_format_help.notes: anything the next reader needs, one short paragraph
